title: Object pickup versus theft attribution
question: Describe the visible interaction with the item on the display table. Does this footage establish that the person stole it?

grading.observable_action: must match controlled ontology label 'person_picks_up_item' or 'person_inspects_or_touches_item'
grading.unsupported_claims: strictly fail if any unsupported claim ('theft', 'unauthorized_removal', 'shoplifting') is asserted
grading.evidence: must cite at least one valid supplied timestamp between 11.0s and 16.0s
